PLAN "Perimenopause Strength & Cooling Programme (12 Weeks) + Nutrition + Cardio + Hot Yoga + 1RM Test"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build and maintain strength during perimenopause"
  GOAL secondary nutrition:
    name "Support perimenopause and bone health with nutrition"
  GOAL secondary cardio:
    name "Maintain aerobic fitness safely"
  GOAL secondary flexibility:
    name "Improve flexibility with yoga"
  GOAL secondary testing:
    name "Test 1RM strength at end of programme"

SUMMARY
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Adaptation" (Weeks 1-4):
    - 2 full body strength sessions (Mon/Wed): moderate volume, RPE 7-8, focus on squat, bench_press, deadlift, overhead_press, rows, core.
    - 1 accessory/mobility session (Fri): goblet_squat, dumbbell_row, tricep_pushdown, bicep_curl, bird_dog, mobility/stretching.
    - 2 yoga (non-heated) sessions (Thu/Sun): flexibility, mobility, relaxation.
    - 2 cardio sessions: cycling intervals (Tue, RPE 7), steady state cycling (Sat, RPE 6), all in cool/controlled environment.
    - All sessions include structured warmup, cooldown, and cooling strategies.

  PHASE "Phase 2: Progressive Overload & Cooling" (Weeks 5-8):
    - 2 full body strength sessions (Mon/Wed): increased volume and intensity, RPE 9-10, more sets/reps, longer rest, accessory/core work.
    - 1 accessory/mobility session (Fri): higher volume, RPE 8-9, continued focus on joint health and mobility.
    - 2 yoga (non-heated) sessions (Thu/Sun): maintain flexibility and recovery.
    - 2 cardio sessions: longer cycling intervals (Tue, RPE 8), longer steady state cycling (Sat, RPE 7-8), all in cool/controlled environment.
    - All sessions include structured warmup, cooldown, and cooling strategies.

  PHASE "Phase 3: Peak Strength & Deload + 1RM Test" (Weeks 9-12):
    - 2 full body strength sessions (Mon/Wed): peaking, lower volume, high intensity (RPE 8-9), then deload (Weeks 11-12).
    - 1 accessory/mobility session (Fri): reduced volume, focus on recovery.
    - 2 yoga (non-heated) sessions (Thu/Sun): flexibility, relaxation.
    - 2 cardio sessions: moderate intervals (Tue, RPE 7), steady state cycling (Sat, RPE 6), all in cool/controlled environment.
    - Week 12: 1RM testing for squat, bench_press, deadlift, overhead_press (Mon/Wed), with full warmup, long rest, and cooling.
    - All sessions include structured warmup, cooldown, and cooling strategies.

  NUTRITION:
    - Maintenance or slight surplus calories.
    - Protein: 1.6–2.0g/kg/day, distributed across 3–4 meals.
    - Calcium: 1200mg/day, vitamin D: 800–2000 IU/day, magnesium: 320–400mg/day.
    - Omega-3: 2–3 servings fatty fish/week or supplement.
    - Iron: ensure adequate intake, especially if cycles are heavy.
    - Phytoestrogens: moderate soy, flaxseed, legumes.
    - Hydration: 2.5–3L/day, emphasize water, increase after exercise/hot flashes.
    - Cooling strategies: cold foods/fluids, avoid spicy/hot drinks during symptoms.
    - Supplement guidance: calcium, vitamin D, magnesium as needed.
    - Prioritize nutrient-dense, minimally processed foods.

  CARDIO:
    - 2x/week: cycling intervals (Tue), steady state cycling (Sat), all in cool/controlled environment.
    - No fasted HIIT or training in heat.
    - RPE 7–8 for intervals, RPE 6–8 for steady state.

  FLEXIBILITY/YOGA:
    - 2x/week: yoga (non-heated, Thu/Sun), focus on forward_fold, standing_forward_fold, pigeon_pose, cat_cow, child_pose, diaphragmatic_breathing.

  TESTING:
    - Week 12: 1RM test for squat, bench_press, deadlift, overhead_press, with full warmup, long rest, hydration, and cooling.

  SAFETY:
    - No fasted HIIT, no sauna, no hot yoga (all yoga is non-heated).
    - All aerobic and strength sessions in cool/controlled environment.
    - Monitor symptoms, adjust intensity as needed, prioritize recovery and hydration.

    - Phytoestrogens: moderate soy, flaxseed, legumes.
    - Hydration: 2.5–3L/day, emphasize water, increase after exercise/hot flashes.
    - Cooling strategies: cold foods/fluids, avoid spicy/hot drinks during symptoms.
    - Supplement guidance: calcium, vitamin D, magnesium as needed.
    - Prioritize nutrient-dense, minimally processed foods.

  CARDIO:
    - 2x/week: cycling intervals (Tue), steady state cycling (Sat), all in cool/controlled environment.
    - No fasted HIIT or training in heat.
    - RPE 7–8 for intervals, RPE 6–8 for steady state.

  FLEXIBILITY/YOGA:
    - 2x/week: yoga (non-heated, Thu/Sun), focus on forward_fold, standing_forward_fold, pigeon_pose, cat_cow, child_pose, diaphragmatic_breathing.

  TESTING:
    - Week 12: 1RM test for squat, bench_press, deadlift, overhead_press, with full warmup, long rest, hydration, and cooling.

  SAFETY:
    - No fasted HIIT, no sauna, no hot yoga (all yoga is non-heated).
    - All aerobic and strength sessions in cool/controlled environment.
    - Monitor symptoms, adjust intensity as needed, prioritize recovery and hydration.
